metadata.title: अनुसूचित क्षेत्र: आदिवासी का सुरक्षा कवच | Scheduled Areas : Constitutional Protection for Tribals
metadata.description: Scheduled areas are one of the important steps to save adivasi culture and their ensures the implementation of special provisions under Fifth or Sixth Schedule. We have focused on the findings and recommendations suggested by Xaxa Committee. We have also explained what are Scheduled 5 and 6 and how they differ in their provisions. We will also see what are observations regarding scheduled areas.
